title: Hⁿ-null sets from a positive density lower bound on a μ-null set (Simon Ch. 1, Thm 3.3)
statement: Let n ≥ 1 and ℓ ≥ 0 be integers, E = Ambient n ℓ = ℝ^{n+ℓ} with its Borel σ-algebra, μ a Borel measure on E that is finite on compact sets (IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ), A ⊆ E an arbitrary set with μ(A) = 0 (outer measure), and t > 0. Assume that for every x ∈ A there is a real number s ≥ t such that μ.real(B_ρ(x)) / (ω_n ρⁿ) → s as ρ ↓ 0 (limit along 𝓝[>] 0), where B_ρ(x) = closedBall x ρ, μ.real = toReal ∘ μ, and ω_n = omega n is the Lebesgue measure of the unit ball of ℝⁿ. Then Hⁿ(A) = 0, where Hⁿ = μHE[n] is the Euclidean n-dimensional Hausdorff measure on E.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (A : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (t : ℝ), 0 < n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → 0 < t → μ A = 0 → (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ s : ℝ, t ≤ s ∧ Tendsto (fun ρ ↦ μ.real (closedBall x ρ) / (omega n * ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 s)) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) A = 0
